topic: Gaps left in the D-67 settings check (security audit lows)
detail: The guard's settings_reopen check (PR #186) reads .claude folders from the call's cwd and the session's project folder up to the recorded checkout. Not covered: (1) settings folders above the checkout (which ancestors Claude Code loads is not measured); (2) a folder spelled in another Unicode normalization than orchd's record is not matched (APFS treats them as one); (3) a checkout's real path is recorded at sync, so a link re-pointed between syncs is matched only after the next sync (30 s). Measure (1) with TestClaudeE2E and compare canonical paths for (2) if wanted.
